changelog:
- Major rewrite: migrated from a local memory evolution system to BlueColumn persistent vector memory API.
- All local automation scripts and supporting docs were removed.
- Updated skill description and usage to focus on storing, recalling, and searching learning memories via API.
- Added setup, store, quick note, and recall code examples using BlueColumn endpoints.
- Described a suggested workflow for agents to personalize and persist learning progress.
- Pointed to the official BlueColumn docs for detailed API usage.
summary: Give AI agents Remember courses and lessons learned. using BlueColumn persistent memory. Use when an agent tracks learning and skill growth; when the user wants to store, recall, or search learning memory context. Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
